owner_authorization: 2026-09-10 explicit renewed cause investigation, including shuffled/reversed/wrong videos and other proposed causal diagnostics; no complete training
wrong_mapping: same-suite next train task cyclic; cross-suite next suite same position among six train tasks; demo46; keep target exact language
static_rule: repeat actual first, floor(T/2), final sampled frame respectively; preserve T and presented indices; all three reported
frame_order_rule: reorder sampled REAL RGB pixels, preserve ascending presentation timestamps; retain original pixel-source indices in provenance; full native prefix/Meta/Writer rerun; never shuffle hidden tensors

predictions.correct_vs_other: same-task video robustness controls sensitivity to another correct episode
predictions.correct_vs_wrong_same_suite: task-content compatibility with target language beyond camera/suite changes
predictions.correct_vs_wrong_cross_suite: broad semantic mismatch; content and video length both change, so not pure temporal test
predictions.correct_vs_shuffled_reversed: same exact pixel set and presented time grid; process direction/order dependence; frozen interventions can be OOD and do not prove semantically correct temporal understanding
predictions.correct_vs_static: multi-state visual evidence benefit; also changes object visibility so not by itself dynamics proof
predictions.between_checkpoints: whether function acquisition or retention changes accompany changed evidence dependence; fixed two checkpoints, no choosing winner

analysis: per-task/suite and individual state retained/gained/lost, churn/Jaccard, goal predicate progress; pairing task/state/env+policy noise; no ranking using offline proxy alone
stop: budget expiry/errors report partial and re-evaluate concrete blocker; no training fallback or parameter/seed search
